resources.string: Your NAS on your phone: files, photo backup, mail, calendar, contacts and every setting.
TitanOS shows the QR code under My account › Devices › “Pair Android app”.
Scan the QR code from TitanOS
This is not a TitanOS pairing code.
The browser shows the same number under My account › Devices › “Pair Android app” › “Without QR code”. If it matches, the connection really belongs to your NAS.
The NAS has a public certificate for this name, checked the normal way. No comparison is needed.
With a Tailscale name (…ts.net) the NAS has a public certificate; then no comparison is needed.
The app does not understand this address. Enter only the name or IP address, optionally with :port.
The pairing code has 8 characters, like K7Q4-9XMT.
Stopped: the certificate does not match the browser. Check the address; someone may be listening in.
SHA-256 %1$s – if it changes, the app asks instead of carrying on silently.
Checked the normal way on every connection.
After “Pair”, the NAS shows “%1$s wants to sign in”. Confirm there – then it continues here.
The NAS now shows “%1$s wants to sign in”. Confirm there – then it continues here.
The pairing code is wrong, already used or expired. Create a new one in the browser.
This name does not work. Use 1 to 64 characters without spaces at the start or end.
Too many attempts. Please wait %1$d seconds.
Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
The sign-in was declined on the NAS.
The pairing expired (5 minutes). Create a new code in the browser.
The NAS is not reachable at any address. Is the phone in the home network or in Tailscale?
The certificate of the NAS does not match the QR code. Stopped.
The NAS is not ready right now. Please try again shortly.
You can change everything later in the settings. Android asks once for each item.
New shots go to the NAS automatically
TitanOS appears in the Contacts app
Events in the phone’s calendar app
Find devices in the home network
So the app reaches the NAS at home directly
New mail, NAS warnings, events – without Google
%1$s. Comes in a later test version.
%1$s. Android declined; you can change it in the app’s Android settings.
Notifications arrive without Google over the app’s own connection to the NAS. For that, a later test version will ask to exempt the app from battery saving.
